en_meaning: To say something suddenly and without thinking
vi_meaning: Thốt ra một cách bất ngờ, buột miệng nói
example_sentence: Overwhelmed by intense interrogation and desperate to defend his accomplice, the young clerk blurted out the location of the hidden ledger before realizing he had sealed his own indictment.

en_meaning: To talk in a loud, aggressive, or indignant way with little effect
vi_meaning: Quát tháo ầm ĩ, đe dọa suông
example_sentence: Though the embattled prime minister blustered at the podium about imposing punitive tariffs, seasoned diplomats recognized his aggressive rhetoric as an empty mask for domestic political vulnerability.

en_meaning: To be an omen of a particular outcome
vi_meaning: Báo trước, là điềm báo
example_sentence: The abrupt drop in seasonal agricultural yields, coupled with uncharacteristically severe early frosts, did not bode well for the fledgling colony's prospects of surviving the impending winter.

en_meaning: Living an unconventional life, often involved in the arts
vi_meaning: Phóng túng, không theo khuôn phép xã hội
example_sentence: Rejecting the rigid moral expectations of her Victorian upbringing, the avant-garde sculptor embraced a bohemian existence in Paris, prizing unfettered creative expression over middle-class respectability.

en_meaning: Noisy, energetic, and cheerful; rowdy
vi_meaning: Náo nhiệt, ồn ào huyên náo
example_sentence: The solemn silence of the parliamentary chamber stood in stark contrast to the boisterous crowd gathered in the square, whose rhythmic chants and celebratory clamor reverberated through the marble halls.

en_meaning: To support or strengthen; to prop up
vi_meaning: Củng cố, bồi đắp, gia cố
example_sentence: To bolster her contentious hypothesis regarding avian evolution, the paleontologist presented newly excavated transitional fossils exhibiting both theropod skeletal structures and rudimentary plumage.

en_meaning: To move suddenly and rapidly; to fasten with a metal pin
vi_meaning: Lao vụt đi, phóng nhanh; then chốt
example_sentence: Startled by the abrupt crack of thunder that shattered the afternoon stillness, the yearling bolted across the open meadow before the stable hands could secure the pasture gate.

en_meaning: A continuous attack with bombs, shells, or missiles
vi_meaning: Sự oanh tạc dữ dội, sự dồn dập tấn công
example_sentence: Sheltered in subterranean bunkers throughout weeks of sustained artillery bombardment, the besieged garrison suffered not only devastating structural destruction but also severe psychological trauma.

en_meaning: High-sounding but with little meaning; inflated
vi_meaning: Khoa trương, đao to búa lớn, sáo rỗng
example_sentence: Editorial commentators dismissed the candidate's bombastic speech as hollow grandstanding, noting that his sweeping declarations were devoid of substantive policy proposals.

en_meaning: Having a period of great prosperity or rapid economic growth
vi_meaning: Phát triển nhanh chóng, bùng nổ mạnh mẽ
example_sentence: Spurred by the swift expansion of regional railway networks and maritime trade, the formerly secluded harbor town developed a booming commercial economy within a single decade.

en_meaning: A thing that is helpful or beneficial
vi_meaning: Mối lợi lớn, ân huệ, điều may mắn
example_sentence: The discovery of an abundant aquifer beneath the arid plateau proved to be an invaluable boon to local farmers, transforming previously barren acreage into productive farmland.

en_meaning: Rough and bad-mannered; coarse
vi_meaning: Thô lỗ, cục cằn, vô phép tắc
example_sentence: The aristocrat’s boorish conduct at the state banquet—interrupting guest speakers and openly mocking cultural protocols—deeply mortified his diplomatic hosts.

en_meaning: having no limits; infinite or vast
vi_meaning: Vô hạn, bao la, không bờ bến
example_sentence: Gazing across the boundless expanse of the oceanic horizon from the ship’s bow, the early navigators felt both an acute sense of isolation and a profound awe at nature's scale.

en_meaning: large in quantity; abundant or generous
vi_meaning: Dồi dào, phong phú, trù phú
example_sentence: Benefiting from the fertile alluvial soil deposited during seasonal floods, the river valley yielded bountiful harvests that sustained extensive urban settlements throughout the bronze age.

en_meaning: belonging to the middle class; conventional or materialistic
vi_meaning: Thuộc giai cấp tư sản, thực dụng và chuộng quy ước
example_sentence: In her biting realist fiction, the nineteenth-century novelist satirized bourgeois social ambitions, depicting how a fixation on fashionable domestic display often masked profound spiritual emptiness.

en_meaning: relating to cattle; slow-moving or dull
vi_meaning: Chậm chạp, đờ đẫn; thuộc loài bò
example_sentence: Confronted by the impassioned pleas of the reformist delegation, the autocratic governor responded with a bovine indifference, staring blankly ahead without uttering a word of acknowledgment.

en_meaning: to remove offensive or improper parts from a text
vi_meaning: Kiểm duyệt lược bỏ, cắt xén (sách, tài liệu)
example_sentence: Nineteenth-century school publishers routinely bowdlerized classic dramatic texts, excising ribald humor and gruesome tragedies to make them palatable to conservative Victorian sensibilities.

en_meaning: To refuse to buy or participate in something as a form of protest
vi_meaning: Tẩy chay phản đối
example_sentence: Seeking to dismantle systemic segregation on public transportation, community leaders organized residents to boycott the city bus lines, depriving the transit company of vital daily operating revenue.

en_meaning: A person who boasts about their achievements or possessions
vi_meaning: Kẻ khoe khoang, kẻ khoác lác
example_sentence: Despite his constant claims of military heroism during foreign campaigns, the braggart was quickly unmasked when he panicked and fled during an actual frontier skirmish.

en_meaning: To wave something, especially a weapon, as a threat or in excitement
vi_meaning: Khua, vung vẩy (vũ khí) để đe dọa hoặc thị uy
example_sentence: Standing resolutely upon the fortress ramparts, the rebellious chieftain brandished his ancestral sword to rally his beleaguered warriors against the encroaching legion.

en_meaning: A bold manner or a show of boldness intended to impress or intimidate
vi_meaning: Sự phô trương lòng dũng cảm, vẻ bạo dạn giả tạo
example_sentence: The young soldier's outward display of swaggering bravado could not entirely disguise his trembling hands as the distant thunder of approaching artillery grew louder.

en_meaning: Physical strength in contrast to intelligence
vi_meaning: Sức mạnh cơ bắp, thể lực khỏe mạnh
example_sentence: The construction of the transcontinental aqueduct required an enormous expenditure of human brawn, yet it ultimately succeeded only because of pioneering geological and hydraulic calculations.

en_meaning: Bold and without shame; shameless
vi_meaning: Trơ trẽn, vô liêm sỉ, ngang nhiên
example_sentence: The defense contractor exhibited brazen disregard for ethical standards when audit records revealed it had deliberately billed the government for nonexistent research expenditures.

en_meaning: An act of breaking a law, agreement, or code of conduct
vi_meaning: Sự vi phạm hợp đồng, sự phá vỡ mối quan hệ
example_sentence: The sudden deployment of naval armaments to the demilitarized perimeter was widely condemned by international observers as a flagrant breach of the non-aggression treaty.

en_meaning: The width of something; a wide range or extent
vi_meaning: Bề rộng, tầm sâu rộng của hiểu biết
example_sentence: The committee commended the scholar’s monograph not merely for its meticulous archival depth, but for the remarkable breadth of disciplinary perspectives it synthesized across history, economics, and sociology.

en_meaning: Concise and exact use of words in writing or speech
vi_meaning: Sự ngắn gọn, tính súc tích
example_sentence: President Lincoln’s Gettysburg Address demonstrated the enduring rhetorical power of brevity, delivering a monumental philosophical defense of democracy in scarcely three hundred words.

en_meaning: Brownish or tawny color of animal fur, with streaks of other color
vi_meaning: Có vằn đốm màu nâu hoặc xám sẫm
example_sentence: Effectively camouflaged amidst the fallen leaves and sun-dappled brush, the mastiff’s brindled coat allowed it to move unseen along the forest perimeter.

en_meaning: Showing irritation or aggressiveness; standing up stiffly like bristles
vi_meaning: Dựng đứng, đầy rẫy, bừng bừng tức giận
example_sentence: Bristling with resentment over being passed over for promotion, the senior analyst refused to contribute to the newly formed advisory task force.

en_meaning: Hard but liable to break or shatter easily
vi_meaning: Giòn, dễ vỡ, mong manh
example_sentence: Subjected to cryogenic temperatures, many conventional synthetic polymers lose their elasticity and become dangerously brittle, rendering them prone to fracturing under mechanical stress.

en_meaning: To bring up a sensitive or difficult subject for discussion
vi_meaning: Mở lời, đề cập một vấn đề nhạy cảm
example_sentence: Recognizing the fragile harmony within the coalition cabinet, the foreign secretary waited until the peace accord was ratified before daring to broach the contentious topic of naval disarmament.

en_meaning: A small book or magazine containing pictures and information about a product
vi_meaning: Cuốn sách mỏng giới thiệu, tập tài liệu quảng cáo
example_sentence: Designed to attract prospective university matriculants, the glossy admissions brochure highlighted state-of-the-art laboratory facilities and glowing profiles of recent alumni.

en_meaning: An ornament fastened to clothing with a hinged pin and catch
vi_meaning: Trâm cài áo đính đá quý
example_sentence: Pinned gracefully to the lapel of her tailored velvet jacket, the heirloom emerald brooch was the only jewel the exiled archduchess had managed to preserve from her family estate.

en_meaning: To intimidate someone, typically into doing something, with stern or abusive words
vi_meaning: Hăm dọa, nạt nộ để áp chế
example_sentence: The authoritarian committee chairman repeatedly attempted to browbeat recalcitrant witnesses into endorsing his conclusions, cutting off their explanations with abrasive reprimands.

en_meaning: To survey goods for sale or read through data in a relaxed way
vi_meaning: Xem lướt qua, duyệt nội dung hoặc tài liệu
example_sentence: Granted exclusive access to the rare book collection, the visiting medievalist spent hours browsing illuminated manuscripts to trace variations in twelfth-century monastic script.

en_meaning: The main force or physical impact of an attack or blow
vi_meaning: Gánh nặng chính, sức ép nặng nề nhất
example_sentence: Because subsistence farming communities lack insulated infrastructure, they invariably bear the brunt of prolonged droughts and climate-induced crop failures.

en_meaning: Abrupt or offhand in speech or manner
vi_meaning: Cộc lốc, thô lỗ, khiếm nhã
example_sentence: Accustomed to elaborate aristocratic courtesies, the royal envoy was deeply unsettled by the frontier magistrate’s brusque greeting and immediate demand for legal credentials.

en_meaning: A pirate, originally one operating in the Caribbean
vi_meaning: Hải tặc, kẻ cướp biển
example_sentence: Operating out of lawless Caribbean harbors such as Port Royal, seventeenth-century buccaneers raided Spanish shipping lanes under semi-official privateering commissions.

en_meaning: Relating to the pleasant aspects of the countryside and country life
vi_meaning: Thuộc đồng quê thanh bình, mộc mạc
example_sentence: Exhausted by the relentless pace and pollution of the industrial metropolis, the landscape painter sought solitude in a bucolic valley celebrated for its tranquil pastures and winding brooks.

en_meaning: To strike repeatedly and violently, especially of wind or waves
vi_meaning: Vùi dập, đánh mạnh liên tiếp
example_sentence: As the hurricane made landfall, ferocious winds buffeted the coastal lighthouse, sending massive breakers crashing over its granite foundations.

en_meaning: Amusing or ridiculous behavior; acting like a clown
vi_meaning: Trò hề, hành vi lố bịch gây cười
example_sentence: What began as a dignified political debate quickly degenerated into chaotic buffoonery as the candidates traded petty insults and exaggerated theatrical gestures.

en_meaning: Gold or silver in the form of bars or ingots
vi_meaning: Vàng hoặc bạc thỏi đúc
example_sentence: To stabilize its depreciating paper currency during the post-war crisis, the central bank transferred massive reserves of gold bullion to international depository vaults.

en_meaning: A defensive wall or person/thing serving as a protection
vi_meaning: Thành lũy bảo vệ, chỗ dựa che chở kiên cố
example_sentence: The framers of the constitution envisioned a free and uncensored press as an indispensable bulwark against the tyrannical encroachment of governmental power.

en_meaning: Offensively self-assertive or excessively proud; pushy
vi_meaning: Tự phụ, kiêu ngạo huênh hoang
example_sentence: The bumptious young junior partner frequently interrupted senior litigators during strategy conferences, alienating colleagues with his unwarranted air of intellectual superiority.

en_meaning: A small house with a single story or low attic
vi_meaning: Nhà một tầng, nhà trệt có hiên rộng
example_sentence: Constructed during the Arts and Crafts architectural movement, the charming bungalow featured exposed wooden beams, an open floor plan, and a wide sheltered porch overlooking the garden.

en_meaning: To carry out a task clumsily or incompetently
vi_meaning: Làm hỏng việc do vụng về, làm hỏng bét
example_sentence: The inexperienced expedition leaders bungled the procurement of essential polar rations, inadvertently stranding the survey team without sufficient supplies for the subzero trek.

en_meaning: Able to float or showing a cheerful and optimistic attitude
vi_meaning: Nổi được trên nước; lạc quan, phấn chấn
example_sentence: Despite a succession of disappointing clinical trial results, the chief researcher remained remarkably buoyant, maintaining unshakable confidence in the therapeutic viability of the underlying molecule.

en_meaning: A complex system of administration characterized by many rules and procedures
vi_meaning: Bộ máy quan liêu, hệ thống thủ tục hành chính phức tạp
example_sentence: Entrepreneurs hoping to launch renewable energy projects often found their initiatives stalled by a labyrinthine municipal bureaucracy that required approvals from dozens of overlapping agencies.

en_meaning: To grow, expand, or flourish rapidly
vi_meaning: Phát triển mạnh mẽ, nở rộ, đâm chồi
example_sentence: Following the elimination of restrictive trade tariffs, cross-border commercial exchange burgeoned, propelling the sleepy frontier town into a prosperous regional trading hub.

en_meaning: An absurd or exaggerated imitation of something, often for comedic effect
vi_meaning: Sự giễu nhại, thể loại hài kịch châm biếm quá lố
example_sentence: The dramatist’s latest satirical play functioned as a biting burlesque of aristocratic vanity, exaggerating high-society etiquette to expose the absurdities of aristocratic entitlement.

en_meaning: Strong and heavily built; muscular
vi_meaning: Vạm vỡ, lực lưỡng, cường tráng
example_sentence: Two burly stevedores hauled the heavy iron anchor across the wet deck, their muscular frames easily withstanding the jarring motion of the rolling cargo vessel.
